name: Call Hellfire

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You unleash a blast of hellish fire. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation around you takes (floor(@item.level/2 -1 ) * 2)d6 fire damage and 1d4 persistent,spirit damage, with a basic basic Reflex save save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This damage increases by 2d6 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
